answer: Proof-of-Stake acts as a primary Sybil resistance mechanism for agent economies by requiring collateral to participate in consensus. An attacker cannot simply fable a network of nodes, as they must harbor significant capital to secure voting weight. The threshold required to influence the network serves as a rigid ridge against malicious flooding, where the cost of an attack is pegged to the total staked value of the ecosystem, making the creation of infinite identities economically irrational.
